environment.physical_vram: 24 GiB unified system memory, shared between CPU and GPU
environment.visible_vram: No dedicated VRAM. The recorded Metal recommended working set is a budget.
environment.runtime: Core ML / Metal supplied by Version 27.0.1 (Build 26A434)
environment.swift_compiler:
Apple Swift version 6.4 (swiftlang-6.4.0.34.1 clang-2100.3.34.1)
Target: arm64-apple-macosx27.0.0
environment.co_resident_load: GPU benchmark processes were serialized. Background system load and CPU development jobs were not isolated.
environment.execution: Native macOS Core ML. Compute policies CPU + GPU and all, with a verified CPU Wav2Vec fallback. Actual per-operation placement unverified.

workload.architecture: Full 30-layer PRO, ten three-layer partitions, two denoising steps, 33-frame window with 28 useful output frames
workload.baseline: fec3bf7 runtime. Set only the audio encoder to cpuOnly to repair the invalid Mac GPU features. Use same selected units for conditioning and DiT.
workload.optimized: Current runtime with feature validation/automatic CPU retry, tensor and color optimizations, bounded next-audio and next-partition preloading.
workload.quality_metric: Decoded RGB bytes in all corresponding frames, same model bundle, avatar, seed and audio.

measurement: Warm FPS = total frames in windows after the first / sum of their inference seconds. Window times include audio preparation/any waits, both denoising passes, decoding, correction and motion update. Total elapsed also includes initialization and PNG/report writes.

cpu_color_microbenchmark.execution: CPU-only helper, Apple M5 Pro, synthetic finite pro320 NTCHW decoder values, 28 frames, five repetitions. No GPU inference in this check.
